assumptions: Named question: which reversible end/edge marker misses matter for the actual signed same-case wood force components, and how are end-component minima shared by the complete ordinary two-fastener connections?

Reuse the frozen 120-occurrence outer-profile inventory and all six authenticated current fields. No solid query, mesh change, new force field, native/elastic/frame solve or design revision is required.

Each saved wood action retains its complete force and free couple at its own bearing-interval midpoint, including its original end-capture contribution. Project the original vector onto the declared stock grain, remaining cross-edge axis and bore axis; do not substitute force on the shaft or discard moments.

For a numerically resolved perpendicular-to-grain force component, apply the conservative projected-component markers from NDS Table12.5.1C: 4D toward the loaded outer edge and 1.5D on the opposite unloaded edge. This componentwise screen is not a codified oblique force/couple interaction or a complete code eligibility check.

The 1e-5-N direction gate is a predeclared comparison convention, not a physical force error bound. An unresolved cross component gives a null directional screen; it cannot silently pass or choose a favorable side. The actual unrounded vectors remain recorded.

Classify each grain-end plane for the signed parallel component as softwood tension toward the end (7D full,3.5D minimum) or compression away from it (4D full,2D minimum). Also retain the perpendicular-component end trial (4D full,2D minimum). An unresolved parallel sign uses the conservative reversible softwood-tension requirement.

Reuse the frozen square-end equation helper. Its per-plane partial values on sloping planes remain unadopted trials. Source planar-face matches and vertex diagnostics do not establish full ligaments, internal bore/channel effects or local resistance.

NDS12.5.1.2 makes the smallest applicable factor govern all fasteners in a group and every shear plane in an asymmetric/multiple connection. Report the minimum force-component end trial across both shafts and all wood members in each of the46 existing ordinary physical pairs; do not assign that trial as complete Cdelta or a resistance.

The eight mixed stacks retain all their own wood-component actions. Their separate complete geometry/contact/resistance qualification is not supplied by an ordinary-pair minimum. Existing Cg bounds, component references, raw mixed fields and material sensitivities remain unchanged.

A failed loaded/unloaded geometric marker records a failure of this declared sufficient component screen. It does not establish a physical fracture, complete joint-code failure or an actual force exceedance. Opposing bearing pressures/free couples can require both sides even when the net force chooses only one.

Parallel-only edge checks for long bearing lengths and row widths, row spacing, oblique shear area, connected-group eligibility, suspended loads below the neutral axis, reduced-depth shear, combined contact/bolt/washer/heel/wood behavior and local splitting/row/block/bore resistance remain outside this directional component proof.

Preserve current100 bolts/66 Hillman axes, retained design, rejected-tie history, panel/screw deferral, excluded actual fit, blank observations and no-slip analytical assumption. No capacity, stiffness bound, floor-friction credit, anchor, fabrication or climbing release is invented; no staging/publication/archive/prune occurs.
